title: Comment “Clone” and I’ll send you the full guide 👇 You can clone your voice, read anything out
description: Comment “Clone” and I’ll send you the full guide 👇 You can clone your voice, read anything out loud, and make AI sound like you, all inside Claude using fishaudio_ai Here’s how to set it up in 60 seconds: 1.Google “Fish Audio coding agents” and click the first link 2. Copy the line, go to Claude, choose Code, paste it at the bottom, hit Enter 3. Google “Fish Audio API keys,” click the first link, create a new API key for free, and copy it 4. Come back to Claude and paste it in Now just upload a 15-second sample of your voice and say “clone my voice.” Claude uses Fish Audio’s completely free S2.1 Pro model to clone your voice, and it actually sounds human. You can even fine-tune it with emotion tags that change the way you talk, like giving directions to a voice actor. I uploaded my newsletter for the week, said “read this in my voice,” and it generated the whole thing. The best part? The S2.1 Pro API is completely free. #FishAudioTurns1 #AI #Claude #VoiceClone #FishAudio
